expectations.text: La reponse suit le format obligatoire : Diagnostic / Plan d'action / Fichiers impactes / Commandes executees / Resultat / QA / Suite recommandee
expectations.evidence: response.md contains all 7 required sections: Diagnostic (line 3), Plan d'action (line 39), Fichiers impactes (line 54), Commandes executees (line 80), Resultat (line 86), QA (line 116), Suite recommandee (line 167)

expectations.text: Les textes affiches (fondateur, badges, ecosysteme) sont centralises dans texts.ts, pas hardcodes dans la composition
expectations.evidence: Scene6Credibility.tsx references TEXTS.credibility.founder, TEXTS.credibility.founderTitle, TEXTS.credibility.badges.map(), TEXTS.credibility.ecosystemTitle, and TEXTS.credibility.ecosystemItems.map(). All display texts come from texts.ts with no hardcoded strings in the composition. ecosystemTitle was added to texts.ts to centralize it.

expectations.text: Utilise THEME.xxx pour couleurs, tailles de texte, springs et fps — aucune valeur en dur
expectations.evidence: Colors (THEME.bgLight, THEME.primary, THEME.textPrimary, etc.), font sizes (THEME.fontSizeH2, THEME.fontSizeBody, THEME.fontSizeH3), springs (THEME.springSmooth, THEME.springGentle), and stagger/fadeIn (THEME.staggerDelay, THEME.fadeInDuration) all use THEME constants. However, fade-in/fade-out frame ranges are hardcoded as literal numbers: interpolate(frame, [0, 30], ...) and interpolate(frame, [540, 600], ...) instead of using THEME.transitionFrames or THEME.fps-based calculations. The assertion requires 'aucune valeur en dur' which is violated by these hardcoded frame values.

expectations.text: La composition est importee et enregistree dans Root.tsx avec THEME.fps, 1920x1080, et duree calculee
expectations.evidence: Root.tsx imports Scene6Credibility (line 7) and registers it as a Composition (lines 53-60) with fps={THEME.fps}, width={1920}, height={1080}, and durationInFrames={THEME.fps * 20}. All parameters correct.

expectations.text: Le fichier suit la convention PascalCase avec prefixe Scene (ex: Scene6Credibility.tsx)
expectations.evidence: The file is named Scene6Credibility.tsx — PascalCase with 'Scene' prefix and scene number, matching the expected convention exactly.

expectations.text: schoolsWP ecrit correctement partout (WP majuscules) dans le code et la reponse
expectations.evidence: All occurrences use correct casing: texts.ts has 'la methode schoolsWP', 'L'ecosysteme schoolsWP', 'Apres schoolsWP'; Scene6Credibility.tsx has accentPhrase='schoolsWP'; theme.ts comment says 'brand kit schoolsWP'; response.md consistently uses 'schoolsWP' throughout. No instances of incorrect casing found.

expectations.text: Duree de 20 secondes = 600 frames a 30fps, calculee via THEME.fps * 20
expectations.evidence: Root.tsx line 56: durationInFrames={THEME.fps * 20}. THEME.fps is 30 (theme.ts line 38), so 30 * 20 = 600 frames = 20 seconds. Duration is correctly calculated using the THEME constant, not hardcoded.
